event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: ITA 219265 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in their absence in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The race committee was represented by Michal Jodlowski (Course Race Officer Area B).
Max Jablecki (member of the RC) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: ITA 219265 delivered a request for redress form using the official notice board at 14:24.
ITA 219265 went to the race committee and asked to watch the video of the start of race 11 (F5)
The written request for redress delivered by ITA 219265 states: "I would like to see the video of my start where i took bfd."
conclusions: The request for redress did not identify the reasons for making it, as required by RRS 61.2.
decision: The request for redress is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
